title: ConformanceVector
$comment: Final Phase-1 schema instantiating typescript-port-plan.md Appendix A. Extensions over the Appendix-A sketch, each justified in context/phase1/design/phase1-design.md: (1) expect.interactions[] replaces the single expect.request/expect.given_response pair to support the ~8% multi-request test families (D2) — Appendix-A's fields are interactions[0]; (2) response.transport_error for the 9 handler-raise sites (D1.1); (3) response.body_stream for chunk-boundary-preserving JSONL streaming (D2); (4) unordered_group for async CDN batches compared as multisets (D2); (5) $type-tagged input values for dataclass/bytes/callback args (D4.4); (6) call.workspace_session for the two-session Workspace facade pattern (D5.1); (7) origin/capability/schema_version metadata (D3, D4.3); (8) expect.error carries class + structured errors[] per R5.2/R5.4/D4.3; (9) call.setup[] for multi-CALL tests — ordered state-mutating/prerequisite entry-point calls replayed before the measured call (D2); (10) expect.callback_calls for $type:callback kwargs (D4.4); (11) body_base64 request/response fields for binary bodies (D4.4).

schema_version.$comment: e.g. '1.0'; bumped on any breaking schema change

id.$comment: Deterministic: <capability>/<module-or-api>/<slug-from-FULL-nodeid>[-hXXXXXXXX][-N] (D3). Slug covers module + class + function + param id; -h suffix = sha1(nodeid) prefix applied to ALL colliders when lowercasing/sanitization makes two DIFFERENT nodeids collide; -N ordinal = same-nodeid multi-emission. Duplicate final ids are an emit-time hard error.

source_test.$comment: Exact pytest nodeid; absent only when origin=authored

api.$comment: Python dotted entry point from the registry, e.g. 'workspace.build_funnel_params', 'segfilter.build_segfilter_entry', 'api_client.get_events'. TS runner maps via naming-map.md §5.

input.$comment: Keyword arguments. Values may be $type-tagged objects (see $defs.taggedValue) for dataclass/datetime/SecretStr/bytes/callback arguments (D4.4). Positional args appear under their parameter names.

setup.$comment: Ordered entry-point calls executed BEFORE the measured call (multi-CALL tests, D2): state mutators (set_workspace_id, workspace.use) and prerequisite calls. Their transport traffic is part of expect.interactions[]; their return values are not diffed (D2 logged limitation).

workspace_session.$comment: Present only when the Workspace facade session differs from the injected client session (test_workspace_crud.py:50-100 pattern, D5.1)

output.$comment: builder kind: canonical JSON of the return value. Encoding rules (D4/D6): datetime -> {'$type':'datetime','iso':...}; selector strings verbatim; model classes -> name string.

interactions.$comment: wire/parse kinds: ordered request/response pairs observed at the transport seam.

result.$comment: wire/parse kinds: the canonical JSON of the value the library returned (result dataclasses via their to-dict shape; streams as the array of yielded items).

callback_calls.$comment: Per $type:callback kwarg name: the ordered list of positional-argument lists the callback received (canonicalized). Both runners inject recording stubs and diff their call logs against this (D4.4).

username.$comment: service_account only; the fake test value recorded verbatim from the bound session (D5.1) — dozens of spellings occur ('test_user', 'u', 'team.sa', ...)

secret.$comment: service_account only; fake test value from the bound session; D5.4 entropy/length screening is the real-secret tripwire

token.$comment: oauth types only; fake test value from the bound session

unordered_group.$comment: Interactions sharing a group id are compared as a multiset keyed by (method, path, params) — async CDN batches (D2).

scheme_host.$comment: e.g. 'https://mixpanel.com' — present so region-table sabotage (D9 S4) is observable

params.$comment: Decoded query params as httpx renders them: ALL values are strings (dict(request.url.params) coercion, wire-seam §3); repeated keys become arrays of strings.

json_body.$comment: json.loads(request.content) when content-type is JSON. 'No body' is expressed by ABSENCE of all body keys, never by json_body:null — a literal JSON null body (if one ever occurs) is json_body:null and distinct per the R3.5 null-vs-absent discipline. Distinct from body_text/body_base64.

body_text.$comment: Non-JSON textual bodies (form-encoded refresh POSTs, CSV GCS uploads).

body_base64.$comment: Binary request bodies (e.g. upload_to_signed_url csv_bytes, api_client.py:7606), base64-encoded (D4.4).

headers_contain.$comment: Lowercase keys. Subset match: only listed headers are compared. Emission is ALLOWLISTED per D5.6 — only library/test-set headers appear (authorization pattern, content-type, custom headers, non-default accept-encoding); transport-added headers (host, accept, user-agent, content-length, default accept-encoding) are never recorded. Authorization always uses the {pattern} form (D5.2).

headers_node_only.$comment: Header names in headers_contain that only a Node runner can assert (e.g. the library-set 'accept-encoding: gzip', api_client.py:1856 — browsers forbid setting it); a future browser runner skips these (D5.6).

params_absent.$comment: Keys asserted absent (e.g. 'interval' not in captured_params, wire-seam §3).

headers.$comment: Lowercase keys; only headers the mock handler set (e.g. retry-after, content-type).

body.$comment: JSON body served by the mock. Mutually exclusive with body_text/body_base64/body_stream (enforced by allOf below, not just this comment). Absence of all body keys = empty body.

body_base64.$comment: Binary mock-response bodies (e.g. lookup-table CSV download bytes, api_client.py:7855), base64-encoded (D4.4).

body_stream.$comment: Chunk-boundary-preserving stream body for JSONL/gzip streaming vectors (D2), captured by the D1.1 stream tee.

transport_error.$comment: httpx exception class name raised by the handler, e.g. 'ConnectError', 'HTTPError'. TS runner maps per R2.10 (MixpanelHttpError normalization).

class.$comment: Python exception class name — the cross-language conformance key (R5.2).

errors.$comment: Structured ValidationError list (order-significant). message/suggestion/fix deliberately unrepresentable (R5.4, D4.3).

details_contain.$comment: Optional typed detail fields with wire meaning (e.g. DateRangeTooLargeError days_requested/max_days). Never message text.

taggedValue.$comment: Input-encoding convention for rich arguments (D4.4): {'$type': 'Filter', ...fields}, {'$type': 'datetime', 'iso': '...'}, {'$type': 'SecretStr', 'value': '<test value>'}, {'$type': 'bytes', 'encoding': 'base64', 'data': '...'}, {'$type': 'callback', 'name': '<kwarg>'} (replayed as a recording stub; log diffed via expect.callback_calls). Codec tables: conformance/record/codecs.py and conformance-runner/src/codecs.ts.
